Scope: Crest 0.2.0 P2 release candidate. Recorded pass rows and candidate hashes below belong to the historical 0.1.0 priority build and evaluate as stale for 0.2.0; no P1-qualified release is claimed. P2 automated verification is recorded in docs/p2-local-verification.json. Physical display, accessibility, performance and clean-account acceptance remain open; raw machine recordings stay local.

Gates.Requirement: Start, unlock, resume and regain eligibility remain hidden until fresh entry/dwell
Gates.Notes: Current startup hidden-state evidence and owner-operated stationary Win+D, actual sleep/wake and lock/unlock checks pass; every recovery waited for fresh entry.

Gates.Requirement: One clear-desktop reveal after dwell without placeholder
Gates.Notes: Owner confirmed clear desktop stays hidden before fresh hover, reveals once after dwell and closes normally. Initial cursor-tool interference was removed before the passing retry.

Gates.Requirement: Leaving trigger before dwell causes no flash or interception
Gates.Notes: Owner completed 25 quick trigger passes within the 100-cycle sequence with no flash, duplicate, jump or stuck state.

Gates.Requirement: Chrome and Explorer foreground suppress reveal without blocking input
Gates.Notes: Owner tested both maximized and ordinary Chrome and File Explorer: top-edge reveal suppressed and app controls remained clickable.

Gates.Requirement: Strict mode rejects visible apps and permits minimized apps
Gates.Notes: Owner confirmed clicking wallpaper while small Chrome remained visible suppressed strict mode; clear desktop fresh hover was separately verified.

Gates.Requirement: App opened during dwell, reveal or expansion cancels and hides
Gates.Notes: Owner completed 25 app-switch interruptions during opening/expansion without issues within 100 cycles; complete independently distinguished dwell/reveal/expansion and off-screen/virtual-desktop matrix remains open.

Gates.Requirement: Start, Search, Task View, Quick Settings and Widgets suppress
Gates.Notes: Owner confirmed Start, Search, Task View, Quick Settings and Widgets hide Crest and suspend edge reveal. Tooltip also disappeared when Chrome activated.

Gates.Requirement: Audio/media controls and registered popups remain usable
Gates.Notes: Current tooltip registration and suppression observed; active media controls, volume and preferred-player popup interaction remain open.

Gates.Requirement: Settings and launcher targets hide island as focus changes
Gates.Notes: Owner confirmed Settings hides Crest, valid test-folder launch opens Explorer and hides Crest, and absent target yields actionable in-island error.

Gates.Requirement: Pointer closing reversal preserves current motion without duplicate windows
Gates.Notes: Owner completed 25 closing leave/return cycles in the 100-cycle sequence with no jump, duplicate island or stuck state.

Gates.Requirement: Background timer completion/track change never reveals
Gates.Notes: Current sleep/wake and pending completion were observed without automatic reveal; current active track-change/app-background media acceptance remains open.

Gates.Requirement: Foreground app on second display suppresses selected island
Gates.Notes: Second physical display unavailable in recorded baseline.

Gates.Requirement: Active/multiple media sessions, preferred player and removal recover
Gates.Notes: Historical empty-session no-op verified; real active/multiple player acceptance pending.

Gates.Requirement: Hardware volume keys and output disconnect refresh/recover
Gates.Notes: Historical Core Audio callbacks and same-value writes verified; disconnect/key matrix pending.

Gates.Requirement: Charging and unavailable battery/brightness show actual capability
Gates.Notes: Nine OS warning-state and four UI presentation outcomes cover retained low/critical information. Real charging, unavailable hardware and brightness edge transitions remain pending.

Gates.Requirement: Running timer counts sleep, ignores live clock changes, restores UTC deadline; pause retained
Gates.Notes: Owner actual sleep/lock checks passed; root observed completed one-minute and paused five-minute timers and verified exact paused restart persistence (296.171 seconds). Native clock adjustment and future running UTC-deadline restart remain open.

Gates.Requirement: Desktop OLE reveal/drop/drag-out, missing source, removal and session clear preserve originals
Gates.Notes: Current candidate owner-operated desktop drag reveal/import, drag-out, missing source, safe open error, reference removal and occupied shelf clearing on restart passed. Root independently matched source/copy bytes and retained only synthetic fixtures.

Gates.Requirement: 100/125/150/200% DPI, display disconnect and reachable geometry
Gates.Notes: Prior shelf DLL snapshot: 1920 x 1080 at 125% effective DPI; 16 productivity plus four readable date/time static DPI renders. Physical 100/150/200%, mixed-display and disconnect acceptance remains pending.

Gates.Requirement: Keyboard, screen reader, high contrast and reduced motion essential operation
Gates.Notes: 45 UI outcomes include compact accessible activity actions and two Settings focus/tab-order regressions. Native Settings Tab/Enter/Shift+Tab and maximized restoration observed on current candidate (docs/priority-settings-evidence.json). Full island keyboard, screen reader, high contrast and Windows preference acceptance remains open.

Gates.Requirement: Repeated animation and hidden idle meet Section 11 budgets
Gates.Notes: Current ten-minute hidden CPU and warm resident memory qualify their independent budgets. Actual presented frames, suppression/control latency, installed cold readiness, hidden rendering trace and battery impact remain open.

Gates.Requirement: Explorer restart, pause/resume and quit recover safely with no surviving trigger
Gates.Notes: Owner confirmed Explorer restart and tray Pause/Resume/fresh-entry recovery; root verified desktop shell PID changed 5988 to 23752 and both isolated test instances quit gracefully with no surviving candidate process.

Gates.Requirement: Clean-account install/upgrade/uninstall, migration and both retention choices
Gates.Notes: Existing-account historical install/upgrade/uninstall preserves saved preferences; clean account and delete choice pending.

Gates.Requirement: Installed baseline interactive readiness within 3000 ms while hidden
Gates.Notes: Current isolated launch-to-readiness observation was 3365.598 ms with uncontrolled cache and concurrent UI-profile launch. It exceeds 3000 ms in this observation; independently cold installed readiness remains unqualified.

Gates.Requirement: Normal eligible hover reveals in about 360 ms including dwell
Gates.Notes: Configured timing is not measured native timing.

Gates.Requirement: Visible control feedback within 100 ms
Gates.Notes: Queued edit outcomes pass; native feedback latency pending.

Gates.Requirement: Foreground hide/input-disable p95 <=100 ms, p99 <=150 ms, max <=250 ms, no visible-over-app incident
Gates.Notes: Synchronous policy timings exclude WinEvent delivery/dispatcher and cannot satisfy this gate.

Gates.Requirement: 30-second actual presentation trace: p95 frame interval <=20 ms, p99 <=33.4 ms
Gates.Notes: Static WPF renders and animation callbacks do not establish presented frames.

Gates.Requirement: Ten-minute all-hidden average Crest CPU <1% of total device CPU
Gates.Notes: Current candidate: 600.336-second all-hidden capture, 121 samples, 0.0301% mean total-device CPU, healthy observer, zero visible samples/show events/enumeration failures and unchanged DLL.

Gates.Requirement: Warm core resident working set <=200 MB with no AI model
Gates.Notes: Current candidate: maximum warm resident working set 152748032 bytes (145.67 MiB), below decimal 200 MB, all five core modules enabled and no AI model.

Gates.Requirement: No continuous animation or rendering loop while armed/ineligible
Gates.Notes: Rendering subscription stops in source; native candidate trace pending.

Gates.Requirement: Repeatable idle battery-impact comparison without unsupported high-refresh claim
Gates.Notes: OS refresh rate alone does not certify frame pacing or battery impact.
